# eigen

OSS-Fuzz: [projects/eigen](https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/tree/bd2ce21991a94a362b92fb1bf25f86d5a1a60842/projects/eigen)

**Status: available.** 5 of OSS-Fuzz's 6 fuzz targets have statements. 20 binaries, 13 MB. 69 statements: 0 proved, 0 known false, 0 suspected false, 0 blocked by the model, 69 open.

Built from eigen (commit `31374a30`).

## At a glance
| harness | what it does | checks beyond "does not crash" | statements |
|---|---|---|---|
| [basicstuff_fuzzer](basicstuff_fuzzer/) | Port of Eigen's basicstuff test: random-size dense matrices (complex float/double, int, long double) built from fuzz values; coefficient writes/reads through every index type, row/col copies, real()/imag() assignment; results are computed and discarded, nothing compared (the upstream test's VERIFY_IS_APPROX checks were not ported). | none | 13 |
| [geometry_fuzzer](geometry_fuzzer/) | Quaternion slerp/inverse/conjugate/products, AngleAxis, affine Transform translate/rotate/scale/inverse, Hyperplane and ParametrizedLine distance/projection on fuzz floats; every result cast to void. | none | 15 |
| [solver_fuzzer](solver_fuzzer/) | Builds an int matrix and vector from fuzz ints and calls triangularView<Lower/Upper>().solve (also on conjugate() and transpose()); results discarded. | none | 15 |
| [sparse_fuzzer](sparse_fuzzer/) | SparseMatrix from fuzz triplets; transpose/adjoint/norm; SparseLU (square) and SparseQR compute, solve against Random() vectors when info()==Success; results discarded, residuals never checked. | none | 13 |
| [tensor_fuzzer](tensor_fuzzer/) | Rank-3 Tensor of fuzz values; maximum/minimum/sum/mean reductions, chip, shuffle, stride; all results discarded (and lazily unevaluated). | none | 13 |

Not included: **api-driver** (held from this release); **dense_solver_fuzzer** (not built yet).

## What the statements say, for eigen
- **`<build>_halts`**: on every input on which the build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise: an input that needs more is not covered), and when the environment refuses nothing it is not forced to, every execution exits with status 0 or 2, without crashing, failing an assertion, hanging or tripping its sanitizer.
- **`<build>_halts_may_fail`**: with no memory premise, and even if any request is refused at any point, every execution exits, with any status. Stated for the plain and UBSan builds only.
- **`<build>_agrees`**: on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding its budget (a premise), neither build reaches an error, and the two have the same set of observable behaviours: every sequence of writes and exit status one can show, the other can too. A sanitizer report aborts, so this rules out every error the sanitizer build's configuration detects. It does not rule out a run that never ends; only a halts statement does.
- **`<build>_disagrees_at_most b`**: for inputs drawn from the harness's `Distribution.v`, the plain and sanitizer builds disagree with probability at most *b*.
- **`<build>_agreement_decidable`**: some riscv64 program decides exactly the finite inputs on which the two builds agree. A program that does so, with a bound on how often it rejects, is a route to a disagreement bound (docs/statements.md).

## Get and run the binaries
    ./oft fetch eigen
    ./oft verify-sha eigen

By hand: download `eigen-bin.tar.zst` from release [v2026.10.0](https://github.com/theorem-labs/oss-verify-proofs/releases/tag/v2026.10.0), unpack it into `projects/eigen/bin/`, and check each file against its SHA-256 in the harness's `harness.yaml`. Each binary is run as `<file> <input-file>` under qemu-user 10; an OSS-Fuzz testcase needs the six-byte header `00 00 00 00 00 00` in front ([docs/running.md](../../docs/running.md)).

## How these binaries were built
- Library: [gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen](https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen) at `31374a3072566fbc9632bfa9f9daad5e391e5545`, built with CMake
- Harnesses: unmodified
- Everywhere: static riscv64 compiled for RV64G, musl, clang 20.1.8 with `-Os -g`, and a small driver that reads the input file ([docs/running.md](../../docs/running.md)). The sanitizer flags and options are in [docs/building.md](../../docs/building.md). Each harness page lists what else its builds change, and which of its checks were confirmed in the binaries.
- Builder image: `ghcr.io/theorem-labs/oss-fuzz-theorems-toolchain@sha256:6a6b4816865c7ec61801ae0fcab6d9c81a599ffcb20616576a9c668abd8b0a7b`. A binary whose SHA-256 differs after a rebuild with it is a bug: please open an issue.
